name: Kenney Racing
tagline: Kart racing with boosts, bananas and shells on five tracks.
about: Kenney's toy truck goes kart racing: five tracks, three computer drivers, 3 laps, boost pads, item boxes (mushroom, banana, shell), a drift boost and a start boost. Race one track, drive the whole cup, or race your own ghost in time trial. Version 1.0 is the original free drive.
controls: Drag on the left half and point where the truck should go; it steers and drives that way. ITEM uses your item, REVERSE backs up, II pauses. PC: WASD or arrow keys.
length: About 2 minutes a race, 10 for the cup
credit: Starter Kit Racing by Kenney (kenney.nl), github.com/KenneyNL/Starter-Kit-Racing. Code and art: MIT license. Added to Lab Arcade with touch controls and a back button.

versions.notes: Kenney's Starter Kit Racing (commit 2f2e5f2, 2026-08-21), security-reviewed, with on-screen steering and gas / brake buttons.

Kart racing: 5 tracks, 3 computer drivers (Easy / Normal / Hard), laps, positions, finish line and score, boost pads, item boxes with mushroom, banana and shell, drift and start boosts, a 5-track cup, and time trial against the ghost of your best time per track. GAS / BRAKE replaced by REVERSE and ITEM; help page inside the game.
